description: Use this when a traveller asks how much a private airport transfer costs between Antalya Airport (AYT) and Antalya-area destinations (Konyaaltı, Antalya city/Kaleiçi, Lara, Belek, Side, Alanya, Kemer, Kaş) or between those resorts. Returns a fixed-price estimate in EUR, whether the party fits the chosen vehicle, and a suggested vehicle if not. Read-only: it does not create a request or reserve anything. Do not use for flights, car rental, tours, or destinations outside the Antalya region. If a route has no fixed price, priced=false and the operator quotes it.

dropoffAddress.description: Drop-off place, same format as pickupAddress, e.g. "Kemer".

pickupAddress.description: Pickup place: "Antalya Airport (AYT)", a resort area or a hotel name, e.g. "Rixos Premium Belek".

scheduledAt.description: Optional pickup time. ISO 8601 date-time of pickup in Antalya local time, e.g. 2026-11-20T10:00:00+03:00. If no timezone is given, Antalya time (UTC+3) is assumed. If omitted a daytime price is returned; pickups 22:00–06:00 cost +30%.

vehicleType.description: Optional: if omitted the smallest vehicle that fits the party is quoted. Capacity: sedan 3 pax/2 large bags; minivan 8 pax/6 large bags; vip_sedan 3 pax/2 large bags; minibus 16 pax/12 large bags; bus 50 pax/50 large bags.

name: get_price_quote

assumptions.description: Defaults applied for missing optional inputs

priced.description: false when this route has no fixed price; the operator will quote it

title: Get airport transfer price quote
